text_block_list.text:
With both the upcoming G1 race and
the rematch
with Нарита Брайан to prepare
for, we're hard at
training. On a day like
any other...
Teach!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон comes running into my
office with a
pained expression.
It's Brian! She's—
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
The URA has revealed that Нарита Брайан,
last
year's Triple Crown champion, has
suffered an
injury.
text_block_list.name: Announcer

text_block_list.text:
She will take a pause from racing to
recover, and
is projected to make a
return in the fall.
text_block_list.name: Announcer

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан is widely known as one of
the best
racers around. The news of her
injury shocks the
world of Umamusume
racing.

Wait, Нарита Брайан got hurt?! I hope she's
okay...
text_block_list.name: Passerby A

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it's nothing to worry about.
Someone that
amazing will be back and
racing hard by next
year, I'm sure.
text_block_list.name: Passerby B

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's true... She wouldn't be the
first one
to make a comeback after
getting injured!
text_block_list.name: Passerby A

text_block_list.text: While they aren't wrong, there have been just as many careers lost as salvaged.

Brian has arthritis in her right hip, which
could
resurface even after an initial
recovery. Things
aren't looking
optimistic...

All right, we've got salted daifuku and
rice
crackers... Should I bring some
books? And
maybe some dumbbells?
Nah, scratch the
weights...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Hayahide probably has the necessities
covered,
so this is probably all we need.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Let's get going, Teach. Remember, no
sad faces
and no moping!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
It's been a few days since the revelation
of Narita
Brian's injury, and the two of us
have decided to
pay her a visit.

I had a feeling you would come, but...
That is
some care package you've got
there.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Hey, it's always better to have too much
than too
little! More importantly, how
are you feeling?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Haven't had a moment's rest, with all
you
visitors... But I should be back on
the track this
fall.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон cheers up a little on
hearing the
news straight from the
source.
...Good. Hehe, glad to hear it.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I was half-expecting to be let
down by
some bad news.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Don't you start worrying over me.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
No point in startin', judging by your
expression.
Well, I'll just leave off with
this, then!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
You better be healed up come the next
Arima
Kinen! I'll be waiting!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан regards Хиши Амадзон coolly
as she
issues her impassioned directive.

Eventually, Нарита Брайан is discharged
from the
hospital.
She's waiting for me, huh...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Hey! And here I was, wonderin' where
you'd gone!
You're fresh out of the
hospital, so you shouldn't
be out and
about!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Ama.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I've been wondering... Why do you keep
fussing
over me?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's with the weird question all
of a
sudden?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
When you visited me in the hospital, you
said
you'd be waiting for me at the
Arima Kinen. Why
is that?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон looks to the sky, as if to
search for
the right words to answer
with.

Well... It's 'cause I can't wait to have a

one-on-one with you.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I get chills whenever I run alongside you.
I can
feel the beast in you when we race.
And no matter
how far you run ahead...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I get the feeling I'll overtake you one
day.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Come on, say something! It's
embarrassing with
you just starin' at me!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: You want to overtake me, huh?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I have someone I want to overtake too. I
finally
see where you're coming from,
Ama.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
...I'm not going to give up running. You
don't
have to worry about that.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Wha? Wait, where do you think you're
going?!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Use the handrail while you're walking
down the
stairs! Are you even listening
to me?!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
So yeah, that happened. Man, Brian's as
aloof as
ever.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
choice_data_list: I'm glad she's feeling better, though.

text_block_list.text: Yeah, same. Better than moping about.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I'm a little curious who that "someone" of
hers is...
but it'd be rude to pry, huh?
She's got her own
stuff goin' on.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, there's only one thing to do
now—train
like there's no tomorrow until
winter comes!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
After seeing Нарита Брайан acting like her
normal
self, Хиши Амадзон brightens up
as well.
